content.title: Routine Compression | Carrier Handoffs to Destination Proof
content.summary: Compress a longer routine into short, causally ordered duties, carrying each cut through posture, a held object, or motion direction. Keep identity and goal traceable, then prove completion through both arrival and one observable result action.

quick_start.input_format: stable subject and destination + one-duty short actions + posture/object/direction handoffs + accumulated preparation state + monotonic route + terminal result action
quick_start.recommended_input: An original adult coastal researcher in a rust-red weather shell prepares for a dawn survey. A cobalt specimen case and consistent left-to-right handoffs connect a weather check, equipment packing, electric-cart transit, and cliff-observatory entry. A barcode scan and opened field console prove arrival and readiness.
required_anchors: Introduce one stable subject, starting state and destination goal before the compression accelerates.
Assign every beat one distinct routine duty and one visible carrier that survives into the following transition.
Make progress spatially monotonic from origin through transit to the stated destination.
End with the same subject at the destination completing one observable result action.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Compress a longer routine into short, causally ordered duties, carrying each cut through posture, a held object, or motion direction. Keep identity and goal traceable, then prove completion through both arrival and one observable result action.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Compress a long routine into short, causally ordered duties. Give each beat one visible action and one persistent carrier—body direction, hand path, prop, wardrobe state or destination cue—that enters the next cut. Preserve a stable subject identity and monotonic progress toward one goal; the ending must show both arrival and a concrete completion action. The reusable mechanism is carrier-bound routine compression, not the source person, luxury apartment, office, taxi or exact fifteen-action list.

invariants.rule: Introduce one stable subject, starting state and destination goal before the compression accelerates.
invariants.purpose: Gives every fast cut one shared purpose.
invariants.ablation_failure: A montage of attractive actions without a declared goal becomes an unrelated lifestyle reel.

invariants.rule: Assign every beat one distinct routine duty and one visible carrier that survives into the following transition.
invariants.purpose: Makes speed readable through causal handoffs.
invariants.ablation_failure: Hard cuts with no shared hand, prop, direction or state feel arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Keep identity and the accumulated preparation state traceable through all wardrobe, prop and location changes.
invariants.purpose: Prevents compression from looking like different people or reset attempts.
invariants.ablation_failure: Face, wardrobe or prop drift breaks the journey.

invariants.rule: Make progress spatially monotonic from origin through transit to the stated destination.
invariants.purpose: Turns many locations into one route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated backtracking or repeated origin shots erase forward movement.

invariants.rule: End with the same subject at the destination completing one observable result action.
invariants.purpose: Converts arrival into payoff rather than mere scenery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping at an exterior or smile does not prove the routine succeeded.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source young woman, facial identity, hairstyle, white sleepwear and black office outfit
the source luxury apartment, cosmetics, heels, watch, black handbag, tumbler and laptop
the source yellow taxi, city storefronts, glass office tower and access-gate design
the source exact fifteen-action GRWM list, ordering, match cuts, reflections and final desk smile
the source creator prompt wording, reference image identity and any visible brands or signage
